PARAMS = {
    "Wn":   (0.42, 0.42, 1.0),   # input nfet stack width (M4,M5)
    "Ln":   (4.0,  2.0,  8.0),   # nfet stack / feedback L (current limiting)
    "rn":   (4.0,  2.5,  8.0),   # beta3/beta5 -> raises vth_hi
    "Wp":   (0.84, 0.42, 2.0),   # input pfet stack width (M1,M2)
    "Lp":   (2.0,  1.0,  6.0),   # pfet stack / feedback L
    "rp":   (1.0,  0.5,  2.0),   # beta6/beta1 -> lowers vth_lo (keep moderate so vth_lo>0 at ss/-40/1.62)
    "Wno":  (0.42, 0.42, 2.0),   # output inverter nfet
    "Wpo":  (1.0,  0.42, 4.0),   # output inverter pfet
    "Lo":   (0.5,  0.15, 1.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss")
    Wn, Ln, Wp, Lp = p["Wn"], p["Ln"], p["Wp"], p["Lp"]
    W3 = max(0.42, p["rn"] * Wn)
    W6 = max(0.42, p["rp"] * Wp)

    # inverting Schmitt core: x = NOT(vin) with hysteresis
    n.M("M1", "np", "vin", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)    # top pfet
    n.M("M2", "x",  "vin", "np",  "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)    # inner pfet
    n.M("M4", "x",  "vin", "nn",  "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)    # inner nfet
    n.M("M5", "nn", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn, Ln)    # bottom nfet
    n.M("M3", "vdd", "x", "nn",  "vss", "nfet", W3, Ln)     # n feedback -> vth_hi up
    n.M("M6", "vss", "x", "np",  "vdd", "pfet", W6, Lp)     # p feedback -> vth_lo down

    # output inverter -> non-inverting overall, rail-to-rail
    n.M("M7", "vout", "x", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wno"], p["Lo"])
    n.M("M8", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wpo"], p["Lo"])

    # first-order threshold predictions (TT, 27C, VDD=1.8)
    vdd, vtn, vtp = 1.8, 0.63, 0.98
    k_n = math.sqrt(Wn / W3)          # same L -> beta ratio = W ratio
    k_p = math.sqrt(W6 / Wp)
    vth_hi = (vdd + k_n * vtn) / (1 + k_n)
    vth_lo = (vdd - vtp) / (1 + k_p)

    # power: peak crowbar ~ 0.5*beta*Vov^2 through long-L stack, conducts ~half the ramp
    beta_n = 270e-6 * Wn / Ln
    beta_p = 70e-6 * Wp / Lp
    i_n = 0.5 * beta_n * (vth_hi - vtn) ** 2
    i_p = 0.5 * beta_p * (vdd - vth_lo - vtp) ** 2
    p_avg = vdd * 0.5 * (0.5 * i_n + 0.5 * i_p)

    return n, {"vth_hi": vth_hi, "vth_lo": vth_lo,
               "hysteresis": vth_hi - vth_lo, "power_avg": p_avg}
